records.name: Powder Keg
records.description: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.

description.value: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.

tooltip.value: Gangplank places a powder keg that can be attacked by Gangplank and enemy champions for {{ barrelduration }} seconds. When an enemy destroys it, the keg is defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes, Slowing by {{ finalslowamount }}% for {{ debuffduration }} seconds and dealing the Attack's damage , ignoring {{ barrelarmorpenetration }}% Armor. Champions take an additional {{ bonusdamagetochampions }} physical damage . Keg health decays every {{ barreldecaytime }} seconds. Keg explosions detonate other kegs with overlapping blast zones, but don't deal damage to the same target more than once. Keg explosions triggered by Parrrley will grant the bonus gold for targets killed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

lore.value: As unpredictable as he is brutal, the dethroned reaver king Gangplank is feared far and wide. Once, he ruled the port city of Bilgewater, and while his reign is over, there are those who believe this has only made him more dangerous. Gangplank would see Bilgewater bathed in blood once more before letting someone else take it—and now with pistol, cutlass, and barrels of gunpowder, he is determined to reclaim what he has lost.
